task.description:
WF-03 Step 2a TEST-RUNNER (.claude/agents/test-runner.md): measure the BASELINE failure rate of the RC-E flake on UNMODIFIED code for Q-1087 / GH #2448. Branch feature/WF03-RCEDIAGINTERLEAVE-20261013 is identical to origin/main (3a4ca1200) in scripts/ and test/; LOCAL ONLY, do not push, do not modify any tracked file (verify `git status` clean at the end; scratch output goes to the scratchpad dir C:/Users/tvolo/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/c--Users-tvolo-dev-ai-dala-letflow/cff9b391-6e4e-4701-8e39-85d2e7a6ea72/scratchpad).
Loop: run `test/scripts/test_parallel_watchdog_diag_test.exs` (the "huge partition log" test, line 326 on this tree; find it) repeatedly: chunks of `mix test test/scripts/test_parallel_watchdog_diag_test.exs --only line:<huge test line> --repeat-until-failure 10` or an equivalent loop that counts iterations and failures separately (one ExUnit run per iteration is fine; --repeat-until-failure stops on first failure, so count per chunk and restart). Machine rule: ONE BEAM at a time machine-wide, ONE mutex acquisition per mix invocation: L=/c/Users/tvolo/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/mixlock; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$L")"; until mkdir "$L" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 20; done; trap 'rmdir "$L" 2>/dev/null' EXIT; cd /c/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/letflow && LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5499 MIX_ENV=test <ONE mix invocation> 2>&1. This test uses stub mix and no DB. Load: 2x ncores busy loops (bash `while :; do :; done &`, kill them all afterwards and verify none left). Waiter floor: do not start while < 4 GB free RAM. Cap the whole loop at ~35 minutes wall clock; target N=40 iterations of the huge case; report N achieved, failures, the first failing assertion text verbatim (the "DIAG line wider than cap" line), per-iteration time, loadavg. Windows git-bash may under-reproduce (design predicts ~5-8% per huge run in a Linux container); say so honestly if 0 failures. Foreground polling only; no Monitors. Result into the handoff (COMPLETED, result.status PASS = loop completed and numbers recorded, no BOM, LF, artifacts_out under result, no self-reference); commit locally, no push. Message ends: Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>.

result.summary: Baseline loop NOT run: 0 iterations of the huge-partition case. The machine-wide mixlock directory (C:/Users/tvolo/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/mixlock, created 2026-10-13 07:18:11 +05) was held by another session for the entire ~17 minute attempt (two waits: ~9.7 min and 7 min); the mutex was never acquired, so no mix/BEAM was started by this agent in violation of the one-BEAM rule. Other sessions ran mix (e.g. erl.exe pid 25684 started 08:01:43) meanwhile.
result.notes: Busy loops (32 bash while-loops) were started by the script and killed by its EXIT trap; CPU afterwards ~27%. Baseline rate remains unmeasured; design prediction ~5-8% per huge run on Linux. Re-run via scratchpad loop.sh when mutex is free.
